nodes.name: Classify Outbound Email
nodes.logic: return $input.all().map(item=>{const e=item.json||{};const from=String(e.from||e.mailbox||'').trim().toLowerCase();const to=String(e.to||'').trim().toLowerCase();const approved=['chris@garagebaggerstereo.com','ethan@garagebaggerstereo.com','sales@garagebaggerstereo.com','support@garagebaggerstereo.com','garagebaggerstereo@gmail.com'].includes(from);const internal=to.endsWith('@garagebaggerstereo.com')||to==='garagebaggerstereo@gmail.com';const body=String(e.body||'');const subject=String(e.subject||'');const asks=/(please (reply|send|provide|confirm)|could you|can you (tell|send|provide|confirm)|we need (more|your)|let us know|what (year|model)|which (bike|model))/i.test(body);const excluded=/invoice|tracking|shipment|newsletter|marketing|estimate follow.up|order confirmation/i.test(subject);const refs=String(e.references||'').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);const root=String(e.threadRootMessageId||refs[0]||e.inReplyTo||e.rfcMessageId||'').trim();const sentMs=Date.parse(String(e.sentAt||''));const reason=!approved?'unrecognized-sender':!to||/[;,]/.test(to)?'invalid-recipient':internal?'internal-email':excluded?'excluded-message':!asks?'not-clear-info-request':!Number.isFinite(sentMs)?'invalid-sent-time':!root?'no-rfc-root':'qualified-needs-reply-and-consent';const qualified=reason==='qualified-needs-reply-and-consent';return {json:{...e,from,to,customerEmail:to,inquiryKey:root?'rfc:'+root:null,dueAt:qualified?new Date(sentMs+86400000).toISOString():null,qualified,reason,threadRootSource:e.threadRootMessageId?'explicit-root':refs.length?'references':e.inReplyTo?'in-reply-to':e.rfcMessageId?'first-message':'unavailable',smsSendingEnabled:false,customerReplyVerified:false,consentVerified:false,optOutVerified:false,atomicClaimVerified:false}};});
